headline: Fed Beige Book: Employment Rose On Balance, With Five Districts Showing Modest, Moderate, Or SOLID Gains In Employment, And With Seven Districts Experiencing Little To No Change; Economic Activity Increased At A Slight To Moderate Pace In Eleven Of Twelve Federal Reserve Districts In Late May And June, While One District Reported No Change; Contacts Generally Expected The Economy To Continue To Expand In The Coming Months, But Several Districts Noted Elevated Uncertainty In The Outlook For Fuel Costs.
